title: Sigil and Garden
author: Rafael Kavanagh
blurb: Edmund Ravensworth, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
